SELECT SUM (o.sales_qty) AS salesQty,
round(SUM (o.sales_amount_currency_rate),2) AS sales, round(SUM (o.sales_amount_currency_rate) / ( select count(1) from dmp_order_info o ),2) AS perCustomerTransaction,
round(SUM (o.sales_amount_cny_settle_rate),2) AS sales, round(SUM (o.sales_amount_cny_settle_rate) / ( select count(1) from dmp_order_info o ),2) AS perCustomerTransaction,
round(SUM (o.sales_amount),2) AS sales, round(SUM (o.sales_amount) / ( select count(1) from dmp_order_info o ),2) AS perCustomerTransaction,
o.sku_no AS skuNo
FROM dmp_order_delivery_report AS o
FROM dmp_order_create_report AS o
AND o.is_combo=1
AND o.is_combo=0
GROUP BY o.sku_no ORDER BY
${item.field} ${item.sort}
sales DESC

SELECT SUM (o.sales_qty) AS salesQuantity,

FROM dmp_order_create_report AS o

AND o.is_combo=0
GROUP BY o.sku_no,o.date_time

SELECT o.shop_no,
round(SUM (i.amount_after * i.${settleRate}),2) AS sales

AND o.platform_create_time < #{params.endTime}
AND o.delivery_time >= #{params.startTime}
AND o.delivery_time < #{params.endTime}
